title: Give a memorable exchange somewhere to lead.
intro: Memories presents a conversation as something people can revisit and explore. The detail view keeps the dialogue readable and places an entry back into the character chat alongside it.

blocks.alt: Talkie Memories detail page showing a conversation, a chat entry and a like control
blocks.caption: Memories detail · Reading an exchange can become the start of another conversation.

body: The design specifies the whole chat entry as a click target. For a signed-out visitor, it opens authentication and returns them to the same page afterward. That return path keeps the original intent in view.
The reading view and the chat entry share the same visual language. A conversation can be explored as a story, then continued as an interaction with its character.
